subject: Post-demo procurement follow-up: vendor onboarding route, W-9/W-8, and banking
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@starlift.com>, procurement@acme.com
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo procurement follow-up: vendor onboarding route, W-9/W-8, and banking

Hi Jordan / Acme procurement team —

Thanks again for taking the demo today. Per our conversation I wanted to capture the procurement items we discussed and get a clear next step so we can hit your desired prod pilot window. Notes and asks below: 

- Preferred commercial path: you mentioned your procurement team typically uses POs for new vendors. Confirming: will you want Redwood set up as a PO vendor, pay card, or via CloudMarket (marketplace) listing?
- Required documents: Acme will need our vendor packet plus tax docs (W-9 if US entity, or W-8 if foreign). Please confirm which tax form your AP team requires.
- Banking: we can provide ACH/wire details or enroll in your vendor portal. If you prefer portal enrollment, tell us the portal URL and a contact who can create the vendor record.
- Timing: for PO path we’ve estimated 7–14 business days once we receive completed forms and banking info; marketplace enrollment may add ~2–3 weeks.

I’ve cc’d Laura (commercial ops) and Neha (finance lead) to help with the packet and expedite any questions. Attached below are the standard vendor packet, our W-9, and a brief banking transfer template you can forward to AP.

Action items for Acme/Procurement: please reply with: 1) preferred payment/onboarding route (PO / card / marketplace), 2) procurement portal link or email to upload docs, and 3) any special vendor forms to complete beyond what I’ve attached.

If it helps, we can loop in a short 15-minute call between our finance ops and your AP to walk through the portal.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_Vendor_Packet.pdf (vendor packet, checklist), W9_Redwood.pdf (tax form), Banking_Transfer_Template.xlsx (bank details template)
From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@starlift.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acme.com
Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo procurement follow-up: vendor onboarding route, W-9/W-8, and banking

Ben —

Thanks for the clear recap. Quick responses inline: 

1) Our standard is PO via our ERP (Coupa). Marketplace is something we consider for smaller tools but given volume & security requirements our procurement team prefers PO for platform deals.
2) Procurement contact: procurement@acme.com — they will need the vendor packet + W-9. If you are a non-US entity, we will need W-8BEN-E instead.
3) Portal: please upload documents to our vendor portal (Coupa). I can open a vendor request once I have the packet and W-9. If Coupa is not available, please send a secure upload link or encrypted email.

We want to get a pilot purchase order in place this quarter. Happy to do a 10–15 minute sync between your finance team and our AP to speed things up.

Jordan
Head of IT Procurement, Starlift Inc.
jordan.lee@starlift.com | +1 212-555-3344

Jordan / Acme procurement —

Great — thanks for confirming the PO path. Per that please find attached: Redwood_Vendor_Packet.pdf (completed as much as we can on our side), W9_Redwood.pdf (signed), and Banking_Transfer_Template.xlsx for your AP team. 

If Coupa is the upload mechanism, please confirm the vendor request ticket id once you open it and we’ll complete any remaining fields. If your AP prefers direct upload via your SFTP or a secure DocuSign/Share link, we can accommodate. 

A few notes to keep the timeline tight: 
- Please confirm whether Acme needs our English-language Master Services Agreement signed before PO issuance or if AP can place a pilot PO against the attached vendor packet (we can provision limited pilot capacity under standard T&Cs).
- Marketplace enrollment (CloudMarket) remains an option but historically adds an extra approval step from internal sourcing — expect an additional 10–15 business days.

Next steps I’ll take now:
1) Laura — will follow up with our finance ops to prepare any additional fields Coupa usually requires (tax id, remit address mapped to bank template).
2) Neha — can you standby for a quick call if Acme wants a live upload walkthrough?

Thanks — I’ll keep an eye out for the vendor request number.

Cheers,
Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
